name: Grade 8 Mathematics – Part I (English Medium)
description: Master the 14 chapters of Sri Lanka’s Grade 8 Mathematics Part I through illustrated lessons, worked examples, practice, chapter checkpoints and revision. Covers Term 1 and the first four chapters of Term 2.
about: English-medium Grade 8 Mathematics, Part I, based on the Educational Publications Department textbook (2019 printing; syllabus introduced in 2017). Develop mathematical reasoning, calculation and application using the textbook chapter sequence. Lessons and assessment items are independently authored; the textbook is a reference, not embedded. Teacher review and confirmation of the applicable cohort syllabus are required before release. Part II topics are outside this course.
